title: Coastal Plaid Button Up Short Sleeve Shirt Color Brown Size Small

descriptionText:
Used.

This Coastal button-up shirt features a colorful plaid pattern in shades of brown, perfect for a stylish casual look. With short sleeves and a snap closure, this shirt is designed for comfort and ease of wear. It comes in a size small, with a regular fit for men. The shirt is made by a well-known brand in the clothing industry, Coastal. 

The shirt is suitable for a variety of occasions, from a day out with friends to a casual business meeting. The shirt's color and pattern make it a versatile addition to any wardrobe, and it is sure to become a favorite. Order yours today and add a touch of style to your wardrobe!
